title: Side menu Add block keyboard focus and activation

fixture.note: The fixture commit adds an opt-in ?fixture2854 seed to the minimal example. Both worktrees are checked out at this local fixture commit; the After diff remains only the two-file #2854 patch. The scripts use the unseeded route and type their own content.

steps: Open the viewer comparison, which loads the two-paragraph fixture in both editors.
Hover the first paragraph and click it to place the caret.
Wait for .bn-side-menu to be visible and verify the Add block button is live (has React props).
Press Tab and record document.activeElement immediately and after 450 ms.
Use the viewer's Focus before/after editor buttons to check the intended exit targets.
Separately focus the live Add block button and press Enter or Space.
Separately focus #after-editor, press Shift+Tab twice to reach the live Add block, and press Enter.

before.tabImmediate: A button inside .bn-side-menu with aria-label 'Add block' and no __reactProps key (standalone script); in the viewer the top-level active element remains the iframe
before.tabAfter450ms: document.body in the standalone script; the viewer's adjacent focus target has not received focus

after.tabImmediate: #after-next in the viewer; #after-editor in the standalone script
